title: 莫迪罕见深夜视频：学生抗议不减反增，考试泄题引爆全国
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Now Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has made a fresh bid to calm mounting anger over examination paper leaks as students prepare for nationwide protests on Friday.
segments.zh: 印度总理莫迪再次试图平息因考试试卷泄露引发的愤怒，学生们准备周五举行全国抗议。

segments.en: He's posted a rare video message on his ex account saying the leaks are not a trivial matter and extremely painful for many students and their families. The video address came as crowds
segments.zh: 他在X平台发布罕见视频，称泄露并非小事，对许多学生和家庭极为痛苦。

segments.en: continue to swell around the main protest site in New Delhi, led by a group known as the Cockroach Gentipati. The departments have worked hard and gave me a draft legislation late in
segments.zh: 新德里主要抗议地点人群持续聚集，由名为“蟑螂根蒂帕蒂”的组织领导。

segments.en: the night. The draft legislation has provisions for fast track courts and harsh punishment.
segments.zh: 各部门连夜工作，给我提交了立法草案，包含快速法庭和严厉惩罚条款。

segments.en: It will be discussed in the cabinet and after taking suggestions from them, a final version will be ready and on Monday when the session starts we will try to get
segments.zh: 草案将在内阁讨论并征求意见后形成最终版本，周一会议开始后尽快通过。

segments.en: the bill passed as quickly as possible. Let's go to Mumbai for more on this Bloomberg senior
segments.zh: 接下来连线孟买，彭博资深印度编辑马尼卡·多希加入我们。

segments.en: India editor Manika Doshy joining us. So Manika considering that Narendra Modi put out that message at about midnight, it does seem that the protesters might have shaken his confidence a little.
segments.zh: 马尼卡，莫迪在午夜发布消息，看来抗议者可能动摇了他的信心。

segments.en: Well it does seem like that the Prime Minister finally broke his silence yesterday, after days of tens of thousands of students gathering in the streets of Delhi and then on the streets
segments.zh: 确实，总理昨天终于打破沉默，此前数万学生连日聚集在德里及印度多城街头。

segments.en: of many other cities across India. But the commentary from the Prime Minister, empathetic but also perfunctory, he has not directly addressed the protesters demands,
segments.zh: 总理的评论富有同理心但流于形式，并未直接回应抗议者的诉求。
